hazards.control: Test the stack to the program pressures; bleed and verify zero before breaking any connection.
BOP drills before the job; kill weight fluid or a tested barrier before the tree comes off.

name: Double ram preventer (pipe and blind rams)
function: The body with two ram cavities: pipe rams cut to the tubing profile seal around the pipe; blind rams seal an open hole; shear rams (not shown) cut the pipe.

tabs.overview: Each ram pair is driven by hydraulic operators through the bonnets; locked closed by hand or hydraulically; the cut-away shows the pipe rams closed on tubing and the blind rams open.
tabs.engineering: API Spec 16A; ram size matched to the pipe run.
tabs.safety: Blind rams never closed with pipe across them; ram packers inspected at each test.
tabs.evidence: API Spec 16A (S48), API Std 53 (S49), API RP 16ST (S53), field practice (S9). Generic geometry; not an OEM design.
